intent: Read the old receipt in /uploads/, compute its VAT-excluded total, recompute today's VAT-excluded total from current catalog prices for the same products/quantities, and answer whether the two totals differ by ≤1 EUR.
success_criteria: Receipt file in /uploads/ is located and read
Each receipt line item (SKU/product + quantity + old unit price) is extracted
Old total excluding VAT and today's total excluding VAT are computed using the same VAT rate
Absolute difference between the two VAT-excluded totals is compared against 1 EUR
Answer contains <YES> or <NO> token and references the receipt file path

args.stdin: SELECT product_sku, product_name, price_cents, price_currency FROM product_variants WHERE product_sku IN (:skus);

WITH receipt(product_sku, qty, old_unit_cents) AS (VALUES (:receipt_rows)) SELECT r.product_sku, r.qty, r.old_unit_cents, v.price_cents AS new_unit_cents, (r.qty*r.old_unit_cents) AS old_line_cents, (r.qty*v.price_cents) AS new_line_cents FROM receipt r JOIN product_variants v ON v.product_sku = r.product_sku;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
see sql tool that takes SQLite query as stdin. It operates with the state of the entire catalogue at the start of the session.

answer_template.message: Receipt {$receipt_path}: old VAT-excluded total {$old_net_eur} EUR vs today {$new_net_eur} EUR (same VAT rate applied to both). Difference {$diff_eur} EUR. {$within_token} — within 1 EUR threshold: {$within_bool}. Per-line: {$line_breakdown}.
